profile_text.body:
IXL Learning operates IXL, which its site describes as a subscription-based learning site for K-12 covering math, language arts, science, social studies, and Spanish. The company says the site is used by over 18 million students and offers personalized learning in more than 20,000 topics, with interactive questions, awards, and certificates intended to keep students motivated. The site also describes a comprehensive K-12 curriculum with individualized guidance and real-time analytics.

Two products are tracked for the company. IXL is listed under Education & Research AI with adaptive practice and diagnostic features, used by teachers, students, and families. Pricing for IXL is reported from a secondary source only: a classroom license from $299/year for 25 students and family plans from $9.95/month. Vocabulary.com is also listed, with adaptive vocabulary practice for students and teachers. Its district licenses are by quote, and one Florida district approved a 3-year contract for grades 7 to 12 not to exceed $226,127. Both product entries note that student age and privacy details are not verified.

No lawsuits, MCP servers, or SEC or patent facts are recorded for the company.
